title: agentilda configuration
description: What a machine should have: which coding agents, and which skills and plugins to give them. Read by scripts/install-sources from configuration.yml.

agents.description: The coding agents themselves. Also the set a source's `agents:` is matched against.

sources.description: Where skills and plugin bundles come from.

name.description: Installs as skills/<name> or plugins/<name>, so it may not contain a slash or whitespace.

regexp.description: A regular expression, optionally slashed: /re/, /re/i, or a bare re. Matched against the name a thing installs as, never its path inside the source.

name.description: The executable's name, looked up on PATH to decide whether it is installed.

installer.description: The vendor's own install line. Runs through a shell, unlike a source's `install:`, and only when asked for by name.

source.description: One entry under `sources:`. The type decides how it is fetched; everything else narrows what it contributes.

type.description: skills: every SKILL.md-rooted directory under `path` becomes its own skill. plugin: `path` is one bundle. command: no repository, `install:` is run instead.

path.description: The directory inside the source to install from. Defaults to the repository root, or to whichever of .claude/ or .agents/ a command wrote to.

adopt.description: Which halves a source contributes. Both by default.

agents.description: Which coding agents this source is for. Absent means portable, which is what most sources are.

oneFilterPerKind.description: A source that both allows and denies the same kind is a question with no defensible answer, so it is refused rather than resolved.

fetchedOneWay.description: A source is cloned or it runs a command, never both. Each branch declares the key it permits, so the matching branch evaluates it and the source's unevaluatedProperties rejects the other. No `not` clause is needed: naming `install:` on a source that clones leaves it unevaluated, which is already the error.

install.description: Split into words and run directly, never through a shell, with its working directory inside .sources/<name>.

pluginFiltersNeedBundles.description: include_plugins/exclude_plugins mean nothing on a type: skills source, which installs no bundles.
